items.title: jline3 leads to ReDoS in Built-in Less Viewer Search
items.summary: ### Summary The JLine3 built-in `less` pager compiles user-supplied search patterns directly as Java regular expressions with no sanitization, timeout, or backtracking bound. A malicious pattern such as `(a+)+b` can trigger catastrophic backtracking and hang the session thread at 100% CPU. items.title: secp256k1-native has a compiler-induced timing side channel in scalar multiplication

items.title: Klever Go counts bitmap padding bits toward BLS quorum, allowing blocks with insufficient signatures

items.title: Gradle causes failure to disable repositories exposing builds to malicious artifacts
items.summary: ### Impact When resolving dependencies, Gradle searches repositories in declaration order. If it encounters connection errors, Gradle will disable the repository and fail dependency resolution. This is necessary for both reproducibility and security reasons to prevent dependencies from being resolved from other repositories without warning.
